title: 速效救心丸的药品分类属性与自我选药适宜性：监管依据溯源与临床证据评价

claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎与冰片组成，1982 年经原国家食品药品监督管理局（CFDA）批准上市。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJPs) emerges as a prominent traditional Chinese patent medicine utilized for the treatment of acute ischemic heart disease, which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982 … The pill is composed of Ligusticum striatum DC. … Chuanxiong Rhizoma) and Dryobalanops aromatica C.F.Gaertn. … Borneolum syntheticum).
claims.applicability: 药品身份与批准时间，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 批准年份来自同行评议论文转述，未与官方登记文本核对

claims.claim: 评价本品疗效的随机对照试验方案将入组人群限定为慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证），计划纳入 324 例。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome).
claims.applicability: 说明适应症人群为气滞血瘀型稳定型心绞痛，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 系试验方案而非说明书原文；功能主治原文以官方说明书为准，本研究未能核对

claims.claim: 气滞血瘀证的判定要求主症加次症，并须符合舌象（舌紫暗）与脉象（弦或涩），属需望舌、切脉的专业操作。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The secondary symptoms are sighing and bloating. Tongue characteristic is a purplish tongue and pulse manifestation is a string or astringent pulse. A patient must have the main symptom and one of the secondary symptoms, in accordance with the tongue and pulse conditions, to be diagnosed with Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome
claims.applicability: 辨证前提为专业四诊操作，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 辨证标准出自 2018 年专家共识的转述，非官方药典或说明书原文

claims.claim: 冠心病诊断须满足心肌梗死史、冠脉造影或冠脉 CT 血管成像证实狭窄大于 50%、或负荷试验阳性之一，均为专业检查。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The diagnostic criteria for CHD will be ① history of myocardial infarction (MI); ② coronary angiography or computed tomography coronary angiography confirmation of stenosis greater than 50%; and ③ noninvasive imaging stress test diagnostic of coronary artery disease (CAD)
claims.applicability: 冠心病诊断前提为专业检查，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 系临床试验入组诊断标准，非人群普查或自我筛查标准

claims.claim: Meta 分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例患者，报告用药组心电图改善优于对照（RR 1.32，95%CI 1.26 至 1.38，P<0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001). … The remaining 41 studies were included in our meta-analysis.
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病人群的心电图结局，未覆盖自我选药场景
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究全部为中文期刊、方法学质量低；异质性高（I²=62.3%）

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入研究的方法学质量普遍偏低（低 Jadad 评分）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Most of the clinical studies included in our meta-analysis were of poor quality based on their Jadad scores.
claims.applicability: 疗效证据的方法学评价，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 作者自述的局限，未按 AMSTAR 2 单独复评

claims.claim: 多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验在 174 例对长效硝酸酯不良反应不耐受的慢性冠脉综合征患者中报告，4 周后 SAQ 总分改善≥20 分的有效率为 60.9% 对 39.1%（OR 2.43，95%CI 1.32 至 4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses. … were recruited and randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% (OR = 2.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) of patients in the placebo group achieved the same level of improvement
claims.applicability: 已确诊、经专业辨证的慢性冠脉综合征人群，未覆盖自我选药场景
claims.uncertainty: 4 周短期干预、样本量 174 例、以症状评分为结局

claims.claim: 该试验无受试者报告不良事件。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: No participants reported experiencing adverse effects.
claims.applicability: 短期、特定人群的安全性观察，不用于推断发生率
claims.uncertainty: 4 周、174 例，不足以排除罕见不良事件

claims.claim: 既有系统评价提示本品对慢性冠脉综合征有治疗作用，但受纳入研究方法学质量不足限制。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A previous systematic review indicated that SJPs demonstrate therapeutic effects on CCS [ 21 ]. However, the inclusion of studies with inadequate methodological quality significantly limited the conclusions drawn from this study.
claims.applicability: 关于疗效证据体的总体评价，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 系对既往系统评价的转述，该系统评价全文未获

claims.claim: 伊朗单中心横断面研究纳入 227 例急性心肌梗死患者，其自述的就医延迟最常见原因为对冠心病无知（38.8%）与自我药疗（34.3%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Factors Associated With Pre-hospital Delay in Patients With Acute Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: A cross sectional study was carried out on 227 patients with acute myocardial infarction … Patients thought most common cause of delay in arrival was unawareness of coronary artery disease (38.8%) and self-medication (34.3%).
claims.applicability: 自我药疗与就医延迟的自述关联，间接（伊朗单中心、非本品、非中国院外场景）
claims.uncertainty: 患者自述归因，非因果测量；横断面设计

claims.claim: 该研究中仅 35.7% 的患者在症状发作 1 小时内到院。
claims.sourceTitle: Factors Associated With Pre-hospital Delay in Patients With Acute Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: 35.7% patients arrived during one hour of symptom onset, and 7.9% arrived after 24 hours.
claims.applicability: 急性心梗就医延迟的基线数据，间接
claims.uncertainty: 单中心 227 例，伊朗人群

claims.claim: 韩国前瞻性注册研究（4874 例 STEMI）报告仅 28.4% 的患者在症状发作 60 分钟内到院，急救医疗服务使用率仅 21.7%。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay and emergency medical services in acute myocardial infarction
claims.supportQuote: A total of 4,874 patients were included in the analysis, of whom 28.4% arrived at the hospital within 60 minutes of symptom-onset. … The overall frequency of EMS utilisation was low (21.7%).
claims.applicability: 急性心梗就医延迟与急救利用的基线数据，间接
claims.uncertainty: 韩国注册数据，非中国、非本品、非自我药疗行为

claims.claim: 突然出现且不消失的胸部疼痛或不适应立即呼叫急救，因其可能是心脏病发作（英国为 999，中国对应 120）。
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 紧急处置边界，直接适用；急救号码按使用地本土化为 120
claims.uncertainty: 英国 NHS 指导，急救号码需按中国规范转换

claims.claim: 官方卫生指导明确「不要自我诊断」。
claims.supportQuote: Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 自我诊断边界，直接适用
claims.uncertainty: 英国 NHS 指导，转用于中国场景时按相同症状条件理解

claims.claim: 气滞血瘀证的判定依赖舌象与脉象等专业检查，非专业人员依症状自我对应证型缺乏可操作基础；说明书适应症以辨证为前提，故药品分类属性本身不能替代这一前提。
claims.method: CLM-003 显示气滞血瘀证判定须符合舌象（舌紫暗）与脉象（弦或涩）[3]；CLM-004 显示冠心病诊断须影像或负荷检查 [3]。舌象与脉象须经训练者通过望舌、切脉获得，非专业人员无法自行完成；未检索到以非专业人员自我对应证型准确性为对象的研究。故自我对应证型缺乏可操作基础，分类属性（无论为处方药、甲类还是乙类非处方药）只回答获得渠道，不回答何人可使用。
claims.assumptions: 说明书功能主治以中医辨证为前提；辨证以四诊合参为操作前提；无非专业人员可用的简化证型自评工具被检索到。
claims.sensitivity: 若出现经验证、面向非专业人员的证型自评工具，或自我辨证准确性的直接研究，则该结论需相应修正；结论不依赖本品分类属性为何，故不因分类属性无法核实而失效。
claims.applicability: 非专业人员自我选药场景；不进入临床实践要点的任何行动项
claims.uncertainty: 该结论为逻辑推导而非测量；自我辨证准确性的直接证据缺失

claims.claim: 速效救心丸在已确诊冠心病或慢性冠脉综合征人群中，有随机对照证据提示改善心电图与心绞痛症状，但纳入研究整体方法学质量偏低，且人群均为已确诊、经专业辨证者，不覆盖自我选药场景。
